acceptanceCriteria: Bounded finite goal authorization is the authority source: current subject, issuer evidence, actor/action/resource constraints, notBefore/expiresAt and termination state must be verifiable; no null or unlimited expiry.

A new goal B cannot use still-valid authorization for A; valid explicit coverage of one goal permits derived B/C Work Items, sequential/parallel work, repair/retry/recovery without repeated per-WI human confirmation.

Authority is source grant intersection Work Item narrowing intersection fresh Runtime admission and existing safety/coordination; identity or authoritySource strings and agent summaries are not authentication.

Finite expiry is mandatory, independently approved from the 900-second single-command timeout; no self-extension or renewal by silence. Only goal completion/revocation/expiry ends its authority, preserving historical facts.

One approved same-goal deadline extension updates the current source version for eligible active related Work Items while retaining their narrower constraints; closed/revoked/superseded subjects never revive and old versions cannot authorize new operations.

Fresh checks occur after lock and before actual side effect, retry, recovery and irreversible publish. Controlled Clock and monotonic budgets cover exact boundaries, rollback and in-flight safe stopping without long sleeps.
Expired management plane supports only bounded own-metadata status/evidence preservation/safe stop/extension requests, no business read/export/delete and no request-generation deadlock.

CLI/MCP share decisions and failure codes; legacy Contract/evidence stays readable, strict missing deadlines fail closed, migration/rollout and any actual authorization activation require separate review.

Design and planned registration only; dependency WI-1086 and all overlapping core/receipt/status/amendment files serialize. No source implementation, build, activation, change to existing permissions, merge or cleanup.
